title: If You're Aiming for the Derby with All You've Got

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the morning of the Selection Races, where horsegirls
showcase their abilities to trainers hoping to be scouted...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWAAAAAHHHH!!
I'M SO MOOOOOVED!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up on such a long journey, taking it one step at a time!
Carrying huge loads without backing down despite being so tinyッ!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!
How... how can you be so amazing—?!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: MISTER AAAAAAAAANT...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Mister Ant is incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Workin' so... *sniff*... so hard...!
Uwaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp!! Don't tell me
you were inspired by Mister Ant too?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I totally get it! Seeing someone give it their all fills you
with courage! Emotion! And energy, doesn't it?!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for me! I've got an important race today,
and now I feel like I can give it my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mister Ant cheered me up, and I even made a new friend
who gets energy from Mister Ant too—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooooo happyyyyy!!
YAHOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (I seem to have become her comrade without even realizing it...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Could you give it a rest first thing in the morning?
Your loud voice is ringing right through my skull.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Taishin!! It's Taishin!!
Morniiiiiing! So great to see you, Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I literally just said... Ugh, my ears hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway... Not that I care, but do you really
have time to be slacking off here?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Slacking off?! I'm not slacking off!!
Wait, what is it, Taishin, are you making tempura or something?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's a figure of speech, idiot! That's not the point—
aren't you running in today's Selection Race too?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then you really don't have time to be staring at ants!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...WAAAAAAAHHHH!!
No way, is it that late already?! Thanks for telling me, Taishin...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... *sniff*... Y-Your friendship...
I'm... I'm so touched by it, waaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
When did this become about friendship, when?!
Ugh, seriously, what a weirdo...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! Wait, wait, I'm coming too!
See ya later, fellow ant pal! Let's meet again somewhere!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For now, I decided to make my way
to the Selection Race venue as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many trainers seeking promising new horsegirls had already
gathered at the venue, chatting about today's runners.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among them, that energetic horsegirl from before,
Winning Ticket, was also being discussed—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is running the Turf 1200m, right? I really love
how she runs~. Always giving it her all and staying so positive!

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You could also say she's a bit too positive, though. Going all out is
an admirable spirit, but heart alone won't win you a race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of the Debut Race arrived.
As for Winning Ticket's performance—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—The lead pack passes the 600-meter mark!
The pace is looking slightly fast!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone's running with everything they've got...!
Allllrrriiiight, I'm gonna give it my all too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Winning Ticket!! She's picking up speed
rapidly!! Showing off an incredible burst of pace!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Her initial momentum was great, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Uuuughh............
Full... poweeer...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the final bend and into the home stretch!
Winning Ticket is falling back! She's out of steam!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, despite an eye-catching start, her lack of race
pacing took its toll, leaving Winning Ticket in 5th place...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ghuuuuuaaaahhhhh—!!
I'm soo fraaaankin' faaastrated—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...B-But I won't get discouraged! I won't give up!
One day, I'm definitely gonna—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san! It's a shame about the result, but...
I thought you had a great run! Good job out there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Th-Thaaank yooouuuu~~!!
Wait, are you scouting me?! Is this a scout?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaayyyyyyy—!!
Let's definitely win it together—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby, that is!!

text_block_list.name: Trainers and Spectators
text_block_list.text: (murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...“Winning Ticket in the Derby?”
A murmur expressing that exact doubt instantly swept through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
T-The Derby? Ticket-san,
you want to become a “Derby Umamusume”?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
OF COOOOUUURSE!
That's why I came to Tracen Academy in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm sorry. Sprints would be one thing, but I just don't
have the ability to lead you to a Derby victory... I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, w-wait...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite Winning Ticket's pleas, the trainer turned
and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaah, I got turned down...
This suuuuucks—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...B-But I won't get discouraged!! I won't give up!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I win the Derby,
it's a FULL-POWER DAAAAASH—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Win the Derby.” The sight of her earnestly repeating those
words left a surprisingly deep impression on me...
